scope: Explain cricket stumps and intervals without presenting them as active live play or changing broadcast eligibility.
changes: Stumps: Play finished for today; lunch, tea, innings break, paused, interrupted and delayed play have explicit labels.
Home uses a moon for stumps and pause symbol for intervals; groups containing paused cricket use Matches in progress rather than Live now.
Shared phase copy reaches match details and scorecards. Single-player match status uses cricket phase rather than falling back to Live broadcast.
Fresh explicit in-play evidence restores active LIVE presentation; stale Test phase evidence remains unconfirmed.
Match lifecycle, identity, Watch eligibility, source matching and player transport remain unchanged.
